bio_en: Khoren Sargisian, alias Petros Azizov, left his parents' home in Manisa as a youth, his family's only hope, to join the revolutionary struggle. He fought heroically in the Khastur battle on the Russo-Ottoman border and fell wounded there. He was later hanged, one more 'sacrifice before the pagan temple of tyranny', as Droshak wrote in April 1906.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Years 1877-1905 from the title; place of execution not read.
